evidence.why: Complete callback invokes COPY_ATTRS with the Crazy Hand attribute type.
Macro implementation identifies the actual source and destination.

facts.rationale: The COPY_ATTRS expansion establishes the source, destination, typed assignment, and absence of allocation or pointer installation.
facts.value: Retrieves the Fighter from gobj and copies the ftCrazyHand_DatAttrs structure at fp->ft_data->ext_attr into the existing storage addressed by fp->dat_attrs. ftCrazyHand_DatAttrs is the macro's type argument, not a static data descriptor. This callback neither allocates storage nor changes the dat_attrs pointer.
